newsitem.title: USA: American White Cross in reorganization.
newsitem.headline: American White Cross in reorganization.

text.p: American White Cross Inc said on Tuesday it reached agreement with its lenders and creditors on a reorganization plan that will leave existing shareholders with three percent of the reorganized company.

A formal plan is expected to be filed in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in about four weeks, but the company said the terms call for unsecured creditors to exchange their claims for common stock in the reorganized company.

American White Cross also said it completed the divestiture of its cotton products business, allowing it to focus on its core business of adhesive bandages, medical tapes, sterile bandages, operating room sponges and other such supplies.
